document_title: First Errata to Georgia Power's 2025 IRP - description of corrections
how_obtained: Fetched the GA PSC FACTS document-detail page /search/facts-document/?documentId=221476 to read its download link, then downloaded the ZIP 'dkt_56002_56003_2025_irp_pd_errata_2-14-2025.zip' from the public API endpoint https://services.psc.ga.gov/api/v1/External/Public/Get/Document/DownloadFile/221476/102589. Unzipped it and took only '2025 IRP Errata 2-14-2025 Description.docx'. Converted that DOCX by reading word/document.xml out of the DOCX zip with Python zipfile + ElementTree, emitting one line per <w:p> paragraph, mapping <w:tab> to a tab and <w:br>/<w:cr> to a newline. No other cleanup - tabs, blank paragraphs and table cell order are exactly as stored in the file. Trade-secret members of the same archive were left alone.
